title: Q4 estimated tax payment
summary: The last estimated payment for the year just ended.
body: If you pay estimated tax, the fourth payment for last year is due. We send the amount two weeks before.

title: W-2s, 1099-NECs and Q4 payroll return
summary: Year-end forms to employees and contractors, and the fourth-quarter payroll return.
body: W-2s go to employees and the Social Security Administration; 1099-NECs go to contractors paid $600 or more; the fourth-quarter payroll return is filed. Theo's team starts the January run on the first business day of the year.
late_note: Per-form penalties that grow with time

title: S corporation and partnership returns
summary: Returns for pass-through businesses, and K-1s to owners.
body: S corporation and partnership returns are due, along with owners' K-1s. We aim to deliver K-1s by early March so owners can finish their own returns on time.
ext_note: Six months with Form 7004, to September 15

title: Individual returns and extensions
summary: The individual return, or an extension, and any balance due.
body: Individual returns are due. An extension gives more time to file, not to pay: we estimate the balance and send the payment with the extension.
ext_note: Six months with Form 4868, to October 15

title: Q1 estimated tax payment
summary: The first estimated payment for the current year.
body: The first quarterly estimate for this year is due on the same day as last year's return.

title: C corporation returns
body: Calendar-year C corporation returns are due, with the first corporate estimate for the year.
ext_note: Six months with Form 7004, to October 15

title: Q1 payroll return
body: The quarterly payroll return for January to March, and the state unemployment report.
late_note: Penalty and interest on late deposits

title: Nonprofit annual return
summary: The annual return for calendar-year nonprofits.
body: Due on the fifteenth day of the fifth month after the year ends. Three years without a filing costs an organization its exemption, so we track every client's status.
late_note: Daily penalty; exemption lost after three missed years
ext_note: Six months with Form 8868, to November 15

title: Q2 estimated tax payment
summary: The second estimated payment, only two months after the first.
body: The second payment comes two months after the first. We check the year so far in early June.

title: Q2 payroll return
body: The quarterly payroll return for April to June.
late_note: Penalty and interest on late deposits

title: Extended business returns and Q3 estimate
summary: Extended pass-through returns, and the third estimated payment.
body: Extended S corporation and partnership returns are due, and so is the third quarterly estimate for individuals.

title: Extended individual returns
summary: The last day to file an extended individual return.
body: The final date for returns extended in April. Owen's team starts calling clients with open items in early September.

title: Q3 payroll return
body: The quarterly payroll return for July to September.
late_note: Penalty and interest on late deposits

title: Extended nonprofit returns
summary: The last day to file an extended nonprofit return.
body: Returns extended in May are due. Desmond's team sends board treasurers a reminder in October.

title: Q4 corporate estimated tax
summary: The last corporate estimated payment for the year.
body: Calendar-year corporations make their fourth estimated payment.

title: Year-end moves
summary: The last day for most moves that count for this tax year.
body: Required minimum distributions, most retirement plan contributions through payroll, charitable gifts and the timing of sales all count by December 31. The November planning meeting is for these.
late_note: Missed distributions carry an excise tax
ext_note: Some IRA contributions can wait until April
